description: Install or update BMad Builder module config and help entries.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{inline values: skip prompts with provided values}

description: Create, edit, or rebuild an agent skill through conversational discovery.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{description: initial agent concept}|{path: existing agent to edit or rebuild}

description: Run quality analysis on an existing agent — structure, cohesion, prompt craft, and enhancement opportunities.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{path: agent to analyze}

description: Create, edit, or rebuild a workflow or utility skill.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{description: initial skill concept}|{path: existing skill to edit or rebuild}

description: Run quality analysis on an existing workflow/skill — structure, efficiency, and enhancement opportunities.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{path: skill to analyze}

description: Convert any skill to BMad-compliant, outcome-driven equivalent with before/after HTML comparison report.
args: {--convert: path or URL to source skill}|{-H: headless mode}

description: Brainstorm and plan a BMad module — explore ideas, decide architecture, and produce a build plan.
args: {description: initial module idea}

description: Scaffold module infrastructure into built skills, making them an installable BMad module.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{path: skills folder or single SKILL.md}

description: Check that a module's structure is complete, accurate, and all capabilities are properly registered.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{path: module or skill to validate}

description: Create a new PRD through guided discovery, update an existing one when plans change, or validate a finished PRD against a checklist with an HTML findings report.
Capture UX decisions into design and experience documents. Strongly recommended when a UI is a major part of the project.

Set up or refresh a repo's agent instructions so AI agents work well in it: verified commands, policy, conventions that differ from defaults, and known pitfalls. Setup, refresh, record, and audit — replaces document-project and generate-project-context.

Condense any input (brief, PRD, transcript, brain dump, design folder, or several sources at once) into a short SPEC.md plus supporting files that later work builds from. Pins down what to build before deciding how. Works for software, game design, research, editorial, policy, business — anything with an intent behind it. Can also validate an existing spec.
args: [path]

description: Assess a significant mid-sprint change. May recommend starting over, updating the PRD, redoing architecture or sprint planning, or correcting epics and stories.
Summarize sprint progress at any time: risks, open action items, and the recommended next action. Can also validate or repair the tracking file.
Guided idea-generation session using one or more brainstorming techniques.
A guided conversation that captures your product idea in a brief. A gentler alternative to the PRFAQ when you are already committed to your concept.
args: -A

description: Amazon's Working Backwards method: write the press release for the finished product first, then answer hard customer and stakeholder questions to test whether the concept holds up. An alternative to the product brief.
args: -H

description: Offer once requirements exist (a PRD or spec, plus UX if present) and the user is ready to decide how to build. Also offer any time separately built parts risk becoming inconsistent. Records the architecture decisions that keep features, epics, and stories consistent. Comes before epics and stories; scales from a few key decisions to a full architecture, and can document the conventions of an existing codebase.
Break the PRD and architecture into epics and user stories with acceptance criteria.
Checks the planning is complete enough to implement (PASS/CONCERNS/FAIL), then generates the sprint status file that implementation agents follow for every story.
The standard implementation flow: clarify intent, plan, implement, review, and present.
Ad hoc review of any code change. An optional extra check after Build's built-in review.
Guided walkthrough of a change, from purpose and context into details. Use for human review of commits, branches, or PRs.
Generate automated API and end-to-end tests for implemented code. Not for code review or story validation — use Code Review for that.
Optional at the end of an epic: review the completed work and lessons learned, and look ahead to the next epic. If major issues surfaced, consider Correct Course.
Use early in ideation or when stuck generating ideas.
Orchestrate multi-agent discussions when you need multiple perspectives or want agents to collaborate.

Use when you want to change how an agent or workflow behaves — add persistent facts, swap templates, insert activation hooks, or customize menus. Scans what's customizable, picks the right scope (agent vs workflow), writes the override to _bmad/custom/, and verifies the merge. No TOML hand-authoring required.

Use at any checkpoint to push a just-produced draft, section, or plan past its first version — pick from a menu of elicitation methods (pre-mortem, first principles, red team, socratic) and apply the improvements.

Review anything before it ships: a diff, branch, or uncommitted changes; a PRD, spec, story, or architecture document; any prose. Applies whichever installed review methods (lenses) fit the content — shipped ones cover adversarial critique, edge cases, verification gaps, document structure, and prose editing — or exactly the ones you name. Code Review in other modules calls it automatically.
args: [path]

description: Test an idea — software, business, creative, research, or personal — through probing questions from different personas until you can act on it or drop it with confidence. Can hand the result to bmad-spec or bmad-build.

Research a topic to support a decision: draft a research prompt for your own AI tool and turn the returned report into a summary with cited sources, or run the research directly here with web searches. Types: market, domain, technical, competitive, user-voice, academic-lit, plus choosing between candidates; custom types via overrides.
args: [type]

description: Hướng dẫn viết PRD theo chuẩn VDS cho dự án Fintech/Tech (tiếng Việt) — orchestrator 6 bước, dẫn user qua từng section, gọi các skill phụ (objectives/metrics/user-stories) khi cần. Output PRD vào planning_artifacts.
args: {tạo PRD VDS / viết PRD / create VDS PRD: trigger}|{--from <brief>: bắt đầu từ product brief có sẵn}

description: Hỗ trợ viết Section 3 — Mục tiêu, kèm phân tích thực trạng và nghiên cứu thị trường. Section helper cho bmad-create-prd-vds.
args: {viết mục tiêu / phân tích thực trạng / create objectives VDS: trigger}

description: Thiết lập KPI/Metrics cho Section 4 — Tiêu chí thành công, với gợi ý metric fintech/payment. Section helper cho bmad-create-prd-vds.
args: {tạo metrics / thiết lập KPI / create metrics VDS: trigger}

description: Tạo User Story Map và bảng chi tiết từng story cho Section 5.1.2, kèm journey mapping. Section helper cho bmad-create-prd-vds.
args: {viết user story / tạo user story map / create user stories VDS: trigger}

description: Kiểm tra chất lượng và tính đầy đủ của PRD theo từng section — completeness, quality, consistency. Chạy sau bmad-create-prd-vds.
args: {validate PRD / kiểm tra PRD / review PRD VDS / check PRD: trigger}

description: Generates an implementation-ready detail design document for a story before development. Slots between create-story:validate and bmad-tts-design-story-pr.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{story-path: explicit story file path}

description: Opens a Bitbucket PR from features/{story_key}-dev into features/{story_key} (story integration branch) with techlead/SA reviewers, so the design gets a human gate before implementation continues. Requires bitbucket-connect to have run.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{--story <path>: explicit story file}|{--team <code>}|{--base <branch>: override base}|{--update: refresh existing PR}

description: Checks Bitbucket PR merge/review state for stories awaiting review (design or code) and auto-transitions sprint-status when PRs are merged. Generic across review phases — currently configured for design-review; extensible to code-review. Requires bitbucket-connect to have run.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{--story <key>: single story}|{--transition <id>: restrict to one transition}|{--dry-run: no writes}

description: Full story pipeline orchestrator — detects current stage and chains create-srs → design-story → design-story-pr → check-review → dev-story in sequence. Shows a visual dashboard of pipeline state and lets you run the next step or all remaining steps at once.
args: {--story-key <key>: target story}|{--story <path>: explicit story.md}|{--step <srs|design|pr|review|dev>: force a specific step}|{--next-only: run only the next pending step}|{-H: headless — auto-chain all remaining steps}

description: Generate Kafka consumer factory config + listener stub for Spring Boot projects following VDS/Viettel stack conventions.
args: {topic: kafka topic}|{group-id: consumer group}|{handler-class: target listener class}

description: Generate Kafka producer boilerplate (KafkaBaseConfig + ProducerConfig + KafkaBaseProducer + Producer) for Spring Boot projects following VDS/Viettel stack conventions.
args: {topic: kafka topic}|{producer-name: bean name}

description: Generate a Spring REST client service (outbound HTTP integration) following the VDS/Viettel pattern — RestTemplate + @Qualifier, @Value-backed host/product config, HttpHeaders with PRODUCT + AUTHORIZATION, UriComponentsBuilder URL build, restTemplate.exchange with ParameterizedTypeReference, BaseResponseException on failure.
args: {service-name: e.g. CustomerService}|{target-package}|{config-prefix: e.g. rest.customer-service}

description: Query SonarQube issues for {project_key}@{branch}, group by severity+rule, then fix in priority order (BLOCKER→CRITICAL→MAJOR→MINOR). Reads creds from config.user.yaml (tts.sonar block, gitignored). Surfaces judgment-required rules for user decision instead of silently refactoring.
args: {--severity <list>: default BLOCKER,CRITICAL,MAJOR — or all}|{--rule <ruleKey>}|{--file <substring>}|{--branch <name>}|{--max <n>: default 200}|{--dry-run}|{--no-fix: triage only}|{-H | --headless: auto-apply safe rules}

description: Install or reconfigure the TTS Shared Bmad module — registers help entries + module metadata, copies bundled .claude/* templates into the project (skipping existing files), then offers to chain into /bmad-tts-bitbucket-connect for first-time auth setup. Also supports a focused rules-only refresh ("update rule" / "cập nhật rule" / --update-rules) that syncs just .claude/rules from git. Reuses bmm config; no module-specific values required.
args: {setup or configure: trigger registration}|{update rule / cập nhật rule / --update-rules: refresh only .claude/rules from git, no full setup}|{-H: headless mode}|{--skip-bitbucket: don't offer Bitbucket setup at end}|{--skip-templates: don't copy .claude/* templates}|{--overwrite-templates: replace existing template files}|{--skip-template-sync: don't pull templates from git}|{--template-sync-branch <name>: pull from a non-default branch}

description: Connects the project to Bitbucket (Cloud OR Server/Data Center) — prompts for the API host URL plus an App Password / Access Token / Bearer Token, validates via REST API, and saves credentials to config.user.yaml (gitignored). Flavor auto-detected from URL. Required before design-story-pr or check-review can run.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{--api-base-url <url>}|{--api-flavor <cloud|server>}|{--auth-method <app-password|access-token|bearer>}|{--username <handle>}|{--app-password <secret>}|{--token <secret>}|{--workspace <slug or projectKey>}|{--repository <slug>}|{--no-validate}|{--overwrite}

description: Convert documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, RTF, ODT, EPUB, CSV, TXT, JSON, YAML, images) to Markdown for the VDS/Viettel stack. PDF diagrams transcribed to inline mermaid (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, ...) where possible.
args: {input-path: file or directory}|{--output-dir <path>}|{--recursive}|{--overwrite}|{--mermaidify <auto|all|none>}|{--language <vi|en>}

description: Break a testing task into concrete actionable steps with effort tags
Generate clarifying questions for BA / Dev / PO from a requirement
Risk-based assessment for a feature — fragile areas, where to test deep, priority
Test scenarios — happy / negative / edge — for a feature
Analyze a requirement — function summary, business rules, user flow, gaps
Boundary value analysis for a field / logic — min, max, just below, just above
Hard / rare edge cases that testers commonly miss
State transition analysis with mermaid diagram + per-transition test cases
Write test cases into the KBKTCN .xlsx template (real Excel file output)
Test data designed against a field rule — valid / invalid / boundary / special characters
SQL queries to investigate root cause of a bug, drawing on defect history
API test cases — positive / negative / edge / security
Validation guide for an API response — status code, body, schema, side effects
Professional bug report — title, env, steps, expected, actual, evidence, severity, priority
Root cause hypotheses ranked, with evidence and verification steps
Suggest additional reproduction paths and conditions when a bug is hard to reproduce
Strict critical review of test work, sharp tone — for self-flagged content {user_name} wants tough feedback on
Rewrite a test case set to be more professional — concrete, executable, deduplicated
Mentor-toned review of a junior tester's test cases — teaching feedback, line-by-line annotations
Standard review of a test case set — what's missing, what to improve, coverage estimate
Quick tick-box test checklist for a feature — actionable, scannable
Effort estimate for testing a feature — hours/days, with reasoning model
MiniApp test cases (Zalo / WeChat / generic) — lifecycle, sandbox, sharing, deep links. Excel output.
Mobile test cases (iOS + Android) — gestures, offline, push, permissions, OS matrix. Excel output via KBKTCN template.
Web test cases — cross-browser, responsive, a11y, form validation. Excel output.
Curate the regression suite for a feature — sync between curated/ memory and Excel artifact
Suggest regression test cases for a code change — pulls from curated suite and adds new cases for changed area
Targeted retest plan after a bug fix — verify the fix + spot-check adjacent areas
Evaluate health of a test cycle — pass rate, risk areas, flaky concentration, go/no-go
HTML test status report — coverage, executed/planned, defect density, trends, by-feature breakdown
Generate automation script from test cases for web / mobile / miniapp
Static (non-executing) simulation of test case execution against source code, with HTML report
Full workflow macro — analyze → scenario → testcase → edge → review on a single requirement
Read a legacy business-logic doc and distill into curated module memory (legacy-logic/{topic}.md)
Bulk-generate test data values for a single field given its rule (50 by default).
One-shot SQL helper — given scenario + schema, returns SQL with brief explanation.
Generate curl + Postman-importable request from a brief API description.

Kết nối và tương tác Confluence Data Center nội bộ (đa domain sản xuất/đối tác) qua hội thoại tiếng Việt — tìm/tạo/sửa page, đẩy tài liệu Markdown kèm ảnh & mermaid diagram. Runtime là node CLI tự chứa (bin/cli.js) với node_modules vendored sẵn — KHÔNG cần npm install. Token lưu ngoài repo (~/.confluence-vds-skill/domains.json).
args: {kết nối Confluence / đẩy tài liệu lên Confluence / connect confluence: trigger}
